title: Creamy Tagine with Pear
description: A rich and exotic dessert inspired by Moroccan cuisine, featuring a creamy sauce and sweet poached pear.
instructions: Rinse and peel the pear, then cut it in half lengthwise.
Place the pear halves in the tagine, skin side down.
In a small bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, sugar, cinnamon, and salt (if using).
Pour the cream mixture over the pears in the tagine.
Cover the tagine with its lid and transfer it to a baking sheet.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the pears are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the pears with the creamy sauce spooned over the top.
